content: {"like":["Enjoys high-energy, witty musical comedies with strong choreography and vocal performances.","Prefers classic Hollywood musical styles, especially Astaire‑Rogers and Cole Porter songs.","Values authentic set design and lively, engaging storylines.","Appreciates well‑directed, character‑driven narratives with memorable music.","Loves performances that blend dance, singing, and humor seamlessly."],"dislike":["Dislikes poorly directed choreography and lack of variety in dance numbers.","Finds weak vocal performances and foggy singing uninteresting.","Criticizes fifth‑rate songs and unremarkable musical scores.","Dislikes films that fail to deliver strong drama or high‑point excitement.","Avoids movies with over‑the‑top acting or underwhelming musical execution."]}
